front.purpose: The forming event class word over the casting seat; sized to its column by glyph count (--pgf-n), ceilings 76 / 64 / 52 (60 under 820px tall).

monumental.purpose: Seat names across the top of the board; 900 for the acting seat and the seat to hit, 700 otherwise; sized by --name-chars, ceilings 64 / 56 / 44.

figure-l.purpose: Seat life, library count, scorecard metric values.

figure-m.purpose: Player-bar readings on wide windows, commander damage.

figure-s.purpose: Threat numbers; player-bar readings below 1280px and in short windows.

headline.purpose: Wordmark (900), scorecard deck name and verdict, empty-table hint.

body.purpose: Prose, tells, prompts (15px), dense tables and buttons (13px).

small.purpose: Captions, card effect text, run line, spent-weather rows; legal footer at 11px.

label.purpose: Every printed label, uppercase, beside or under its figure, in --muted; the active event's head label in ink.

chip.purpose: State words inside a square hairline box.

key.purpose: The character inside an 18px key square.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: The world has no shadows; the name survives so old declarations resolve to nothing. A floating thing is separated by a 1px border on opaque paper.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The one authored easing: letters settling into a front, the fronts settling on turn advance.

motion.name: front-settle
motion.value: 560ms ease-settle, 24ms stagger per letter, 300ms cap; from translateY(-offset) in --silver to rest in --ink; flash letters hold silver to 84%
motion.purpose: A new event's class word forming over its seat.

motion.name: rainfall
motion.purpose: The 14 to 20 letterforms falling in under the forming word, inside a 40px clipped strip.

motion.name: strike
motion.value: 180ms linear, scaleX(0) to scaleX(1) from the left, 1px --rain at 54% of the word
motion.purpose: An answered or resolved front going spent.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.purpose: The event sheet appearing under the formed word.

motion.name: front-settle-turn
motion.value: 240ms ease-settle, opacity 0.3 to 1, translateY(3px) to 0, delays 0 / 60 / 120ms
motion.purpose: The three seat fronts settling in reading order on turn advance (data-settle alternates a / b to replay).

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Card tap, drag ghost, edge and colour changes on hover; exits no slower than entrances.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; formed word in ink, strike already drawn, fronts settled
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion shows every finished state and loses nothing.

breakpoints.name: names-step-1
breakpoints.purpose: Seat names 64 to 56, front word 76 to 64, player-bar figures 24 to 19, HIT chip dropped (tracking still says it).

breakpoints.name: names-step-2
breakpoints.purpose: Seat names 56 to 44, front word 64 to 52, spent-weather margin strip hidden and its margin closed.

breakpoints.name: short-window
breakpoints.purpose: Title bar 44 to 38, --hud-top 208 to 182, seat names 56, front word 60, life figure 26, event sheet tightens.

breakpoints.name: table-max
breakpoints.purpose: Seat fronts and the zone strip centre inside this; the battlefield keeps the whole window.

breakpoints.name: floor
breakpoints.purpose: The narrowest supported window; the hand never collapses. 390px is out of scope by decision.

components.css: .ds-pgf { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #101010); user-select: none; } .ds-pgf-word { position: relative; display: flex; font-size: 76px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 0.8; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pgf-word span { display: inline-block; animation: ds-settle 560ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; animation-delay: var(--d, 0ms); } .ds-pgf-word span.flash { animation-name: ds-settle-flash; } .ds-pgf-rain { position: relative; height: 40px; margin-top: -12px; overflow: hidden; animation: ds-rainfall 560ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-pgf-rain i { position: absolute; font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; color: var(--rain, #b9bdc4); } .ds-pgf-rain i.ink { color: var(--ink, #101010); } @keyframes ds-settle { from { transform: translateY(calc(var(--y, 0px) * -1)); color: var(--silver, #d8dde3); } to { transform: none; color: var(--ink, #101010); } } @keyframes ds-settle-flash { from { transform: translateY(calc(var(--y, 0px) * -1)); color: var(--silver, #d8dde3); } 84% { color: var(--silver, #d8dde3); } to { transform: none; color: var(--ink, #101010); } } @keyframes ds-rainfall { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-12px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-pgf-word span, .ds-pgf-rain { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Pressure is typographic weather. The whole app is one paper-white field with one grotesk on it, and the only mass on screen is type: three seat names set monumental across the top of the board, each seat's readings sitting inside its own name's measure, and an event's class word (BOARD WIPE, REMOVAL, COUNTERSPELL, COMBAT, RACE CLOCK, RESOURCE, HATE PIECE) gathering over the seat that cast it, coming apart into a short rain of its own letters, then turning rain grey with a strike once it is answered or resolved. The Scryfall card faces are the only image in the world and are never treated; the type stands beside and above them, on the same paper.

Nothing here is a panel. There are no fills, no shadows, no radii, no gradients, no blur and no glass. Structure is a 1px hairline where a block needs a rule, a 2px ink rule where a block is the one thing asking to be read, and exactly one reversed ink plate per screen (the active event's key-1 response during a run; the deck rail's Start run between runs). Emphasis is weight, tracking and that one plate; "act now" is not a colour. The world admits two hues, danger and ok, and both always print their word. Mana colours exist only as a mnemonic beside the word or letter they name.

Density is a reading, not a dashboard: every figure is lining and tabular, sized by rank (32 / 24 / 19 at 700), labelled by an 11px tracked caption beside or under it, and the whole HUD stands in the board's own margins rather than in a rail. The night field (data-theme="dark") is the same design with every token swapped; no rule anywhere knows which theme is up. Confirmed anti-references: the previous "Kneeboard" world (dark matte, IBM Plex Sans with a Marcellus wordmark, brass accent, translucent HUD panes, printed label-over-figure slots), literal instruments of any kind (gauges, needles, dials, lamps, rendered props), and the dark gaming client with panels laid over the table.
keyCharacteristics: One surface: --ground is every surface, including the board, the strip, the rail, inputs and overlays; --surface equals --ground by design.
One family: Archivo Variable (self-hosted, wdth build), 400 through 900; weight, size and tracking carry rank.
One rule, one plate: a single 2px storm rule and a single reversed ink plate per screen.
Two hues plus mnemonics: --danger and --ok always beside their word; mana colours only beside the class word or colour letter.
No depth at all: --shadow tokens resolve to transparent; a floating thing is separated by a 1px border on opaque paper.
Weather is the only authored motion: the forming front (560ms), its rain, its strike, and the fronts' settle on turn advance (240ms).

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: Exactly one element per screen is reversed (ink fill, paper letters, 2px ink edge): the active event's key-1 response during a run, the deck rail's Start run between runs. The answer picker's picked row reverses only while the picker is open on its own. Nothing else on the field carries a fill.

rules.name: The Word Beside It Rule
rules.body: No colour stands alone. Danger and ok print beside their word (LIFE -5, WIN, ERROR); a mana colour appears only as a swatch or letter next to the class word or colour letter it names; a spent front is grey and struck, an eliminated seat is grey and struck and says OUT.

rules.name: The Rain Rule
rules.body: --rain marks what has passed and nothing else. Anything the player still has to act on is set in ink or muted.

rules.name: The Weight Carries Rank Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is weight and size in one family: 900 for a name or a front, 700 for a figure or a heading, 500 for a label or a chip, 400 for prose. A second family, a serif, or an italic display voice is outside the world.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: A monumental name and a front word are sized to the column they stand in, by character count, never by a breakpoint alone; a long name gets smaller, it never wraps and never covers a card face.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: A floating thing is separated by its border, never by a shadow, a blur or a translucent pane. If a block must be read over card art, it is opaque paper.

rules.name: The One Rule Rule
rules.body: Exactly one 2px ink rule per screen: the storm rule across the top of the active event sheet. The open tab's underline and the commander's ring are also 2px ink but are outlines of a state, not a second sheet. Every other rule is a 1px hairline.

dos: Do set every surface on --ground; the board, the strip, the rail, inputs and overlays are the same paper.
Do carry rank with weight in one family: 900 names and fronts, 700 figures and headings, 500 labels and chips, 400 prose.
Do size a monumental name by its column and character count (--name-chars) and a front word by its glyph count (--pgf-n), so long words get smaller rather than wrapping or covering a face.
Do print a label beside or under its figure, 11px 500 uppercase tracked 0.16em in --muted.
Do draw structure as 1px hairlines, and spend the single 2px ink rule on the active event sheet.
Do reverse exactly one element per screen: the key-1 response during a run, Start run between runs.
Do put every state in a word: OUT, HIT, TURN, ARMED 4+, QUEUED: COMBAT, WIN, ERROR; a colour, a strike or a grey never stands alone.
Do make an occluding block opaque paper with a hairline edge and no shadow, and keep the forming word inside the board's top clearance so it never covers a card.
Do keep --rain for what has passed and --silver for a word still forming.
Do ship every authored motion with a reduced-motion fallback that shows the finished state.
donts: Don't add a fill, a shadow, a blur, a gradient, a glow, a grain or a radius; card faces alone keep their 5px corner.
Don't use a second type family, a serif, or the old Marcellus wordmark; the wordmark is the body face at 900.
Don't make --accent or --rule differ from --ink; emphasis is weight, tracking and the one plate.
Don't use a mana colour as a fill, a border or a word colour anywhere but beside the class word or colour letter it names.
Don't use --danger on a resting control or as a fill; it is life leaving, the losing verdict, and text after the word ERROR.
Don't draw pill chips, tiles, cards-with-borders or a translucent pane over a Scryfall face.
Don't add literal instruments (gauges, needles, dials, lamps) or icon glyphs; every action is a word, a key square, or a hairline mark.
Don't hide the hand or add motion that interrupts play; hover changes only an edge or a colour, and nothing moves.
